grader.scenario: Mobile number port-in (PAC) split-routing between old network and S-Net

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opening 'Thank you for calling S-Net mobile technical support' in first turn and closing 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in last turns.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Two managed holds announced ('Bear with me for a couple of minutes', 'One moment while I route the test call') and properly thanked without unmanaged gaps.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent asked for date of birth and account reference number at [00:27], never asking for PIN, address, or security question.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent never used the customer's name Anika anywhere in the dialogue.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: When customer expressed distress at [01:32] over business disruption and lost contracts, agent explicitly acknowledged at [01:53]: 'I completely understand how stressful and frustrating that is when your business clients cannot reach you and it impacts your work.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent only echoed the mobile phone number at [01:20] ('Okay, so the mobile number is 07700 900381') without ever paraphrasing the split-routing problem.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent did not repeat any questions and tracked all porting details provided.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent explicitly stated 'I am going to take full ownership of this' and directly executed the MNPO clearinghouse update rather than deflecting to Vodafone.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent remained courteous, supportive, and professional throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed effectively on timing of port, caller networks, and outgoing CLI display.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Agent initiated an external test call which rang customer's phone; customer answered and confirmed inbound calls are fully restored.
